description: PRD-206 — S3 Signed URL Tenant Scoping. Move the tenant-prefix assertion INTO the S3 helper layer so every signed URL / upload is checked against the caller's `tenants/{tenantId}/` prefix before it is issued. Today `getFileUrl(key)` (lib/s3.ts:60) signs ANY key with no caller-tenant check, `uploadFile` (lib/s3.ts:28) trusts a caller-supplied prefix, the two upload routes guard with a BYPASSABLE substring `.includes('tenants/{id}/')` check, and `signS3Path` (app/store/preview/[templateSlug]/page.tsx:72) has an absolute-path passthrough that signs `tenants/<other>/...` verbatim. Fix: a strict path-segment-prefix guard in a new lib/s3-tenant-guard.ts, enforced inside getFileUrl + uploadFile, with an explicit audited super-admin bypass; remove the route substring checks; close the preview passthrough. CRITICAL CONSTRAINT: getFileUrl has ~20 callers and uploadFile ~15 across the app — the scope argument MUST be added in a BACKWARD-COMPATIBLE way (new options form accepted alongside the legacy form) so per-story typecheck stays green; this PRD migrates ONLY the 4 security-relevant call sites named below, NOT all callers (the 'zero unscoped calls' CI gate is PRD-216). App lives in nextjs_space/ (pnpm 10.30.2, Next 14.2.35, Prisma 6.7). Error envelope: lib/api-error.ts (ApiError class: `new ApiError(message, status, safeForClient?)`). S3 keys carry an optional folderPrefix from getBucketConfig() (e.g. 'development/') that the guard MUST account for. Source PRD: docs/PRDS/REMEDIATION/PRD-206-s3-signed-url-tenant-scoping.md. Phased: Phase 1 (US-001..010) autonomous node-only (Vitest unit) — guard + enforcement + the 4 call-site migrations + unit tests; Phase 2 (US-011..012) integration tests REQUIRE a Docker daemon (testcontainers + S3 mock) — BLOCKED-DOCKER if `docker info` fails; Phase 3 (US-013) Playwright E2E BLOCKED-NEEDS-AUTH-DECISION on PRD-207 OQ-1 (Clerk test-auth, owner Gerard). Global rules: NEVER hardcode template-specific values (S3 is source of truth); immutable updates; no console.log in production code (test files may log); .env.test holds only throwaway test values, never real/Railway secrets.

userStories.title: lib/s3-tenant-guard.ts — strict path-segment prefix guard + normaliser (AC-1)
userStories.description: As a developer, I want assertKeyInTenantScope(key, tenantId) that throws ApiError(403) unless key is within the caller's tenants/{tenantId}/ prefix, using a STRICT path-segment prefix (not substring .includes).
acceptanceCriteria: Create nextjs_space/lib/s3-tenant-guard.ts exporting `export function assertKeyInTenantScope(key: string, tenantId: string, opts?: { folderPrefix?: string }): void`
Throws `new ApiError('Cross-tenant S3 access denied', 403)` (import from '@/lib/api-error') when out of scope or tenantId is empty

Normalise before comparing: percent-decode once (reject if decode throws); REJECT any key containing '..' or a backslash; collapse repeated '/'; strip a single leading '/'; strip opts.folderPrefix from the start if present
After normalising, assert the remainder begins with the exact segment `tenants/${tenantId}/` (trailing slash enforces a segment boundary) — NOT a substring match anywhere in the string
Also export a boolean helper `export function isKeyInTenantScope(key, tenantId, opts?): boolean` (the non-throwing form signS3Path will use in US-009)
File is < 800 lines, functions < 50 lines, no console.log
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Implements PRD §4 AC-1. The whole point is to defeat the bypassable `.includes` check at upload/route.ts:51 and branding/upload/route.ts:67. ApiError signature (lib/api-error.ts:21): `new ApiError(message, status=500, safeForClient=true)` — so `new ApiError('Cross-tenant S3 access denied', 403)` is correct and apiError() will pass its message through. folderPrefix comes from getBucketConfig() (lib/aws-config.ts) e.g. 'development/'; the guard takes it as an arg so it stays pure/testable (no S3 calls inside the guard). Do NOT call getBucketConfig inside the guard — callers pass folderPrefix. No tests in THIS story (US-003 owns them).
